text:
Snow, lights and hot wine
under the TV Tower ❄️

This is Sapporo's Odori Park in December.
The White Illumination (46 years running)
and the Munich Christmas Market
share the same park.

The market's mug has a new design every year.

Follow Japan by Station for one Japan place a day.

#Sapporo #Hokkaido #OdoriPark #JapanInWinter #JapanTravel
